_comment: Copy to pricing.json and fill in from your provider's official pricing page. Prices are USD per 1 million tokens. Keys are 'provider:model-id' as TradingAgents names them (or a bare model id). This template is rejected as-is (null prices, placeholder date), so cost limits fail closed until it is filled in. cached_input_per_mtok may stay null: cached input is then charged at the full input rate. For a provider with no per-token bill (chatgpt plan, a local ollama), write 0 explicitly. cache_write_per_mtok (prompt-cache writes, e.g. Anthropic) may stay null: writes are then charged at twice the input rate.
source: URL of the pricing page these prices were copied from
